config.label: Optional bearer JWT for paid-tier callers
config.description: Optional bearer JWT for paid-tier callers. Mint at https://instanode.dev/dashboard → 'API token for CLI / agent'. Lifts the free-tier 5-per-subnet-per-day provisioning cap and auto-links new resources to your account. Leave unset to use the free tier anonymously.

config.label: Override the API base URL
config.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://api.instanode.dev. Useful for self-hosted deployments.
